title: DS101 - Mathematics for Data Science
details: Covers mathematical foundations essential for data science including calculus, optimization, and numerical methods. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: CS105 - Problem Solving through Programming
details: Introduction to computational thinking and programming using Python/C. Covers loops, arrays, functions, and basic algorithms. Credits: 3-1-2-0-5

title: DS104 - Data Science and AI Applications
details: Overview of real-world applications of data science and artificial intelligence across industries. Credits: 3-0-0-4-4

title: DS105 - Probability and Statistics
details: Fundamentals of probability theory, statistical distributions, hypothesis testing, and data analysis techniques. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: CS102 - Data Structures
details: Study of fundamental data structures such as stacks, queues, trees, graphs, and hash tables. Prerequisite: CS105. Credits: 3-1-2-0-5

title: DS201 - Data and Business Analytics
details: Techniques for extracting insights from business data using descriptive and predictive analytics. Credits: 3-0-2-0-4

title: CS201 - Discrete Mathematics
details: Covers logic, set theory, combinatorics, graph theory, and mathematical structures used in CS. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: CS207 - Object Oriented Programming
details: Learn OOP concepts using Java/C++ including classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and design patterns. Prerequisite: CS105. Credits: 3-0-2-0-4

title: CS202 - Design & Analysis of Algorithms
details: Study of algorithm design paradigms including divide-and-conquer, greedy, dynamic programming. Prerequisite: CS102. Credits: 3-1-2-0-5

title: MA202 - Linear Algebra
details: Vector spaces, matrices, eigenvalues, linear transformations, and applications in machine learning. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: DS203 - Operating Systems and Cloud Computing
details: Fundamentals of OS concepts and introduction to cloud computing platforms and services. Prerequisite: CS102. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: CS310 - Database Management Systems
details: Relational databases, SQL, normalization, transaction processing, and NoSQL databases. Prerequisite: CS102. Credits: 3-1-2-0-5

title: DS204 - Software Engineering and Services
details: Software development lifecycle, agile methodologies, microservices, and RESTful API design. Prerequisite: CS105. Credits: 3-0-2-0-4

title: DS301 - Graphs and Social Networks
details: Analysis of complex networks, community detection, influence propagation, and graph algorithms. Prerequisite: CS201. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: DS302 - Computer Communication Networks
details: Network architectures, protocols (TCP/IP), routing, and network security fundamentals. Prerequisite: CS102. Credits: 3-1-2-0-5

title: DS303 - Algorithms and Artificial Intelligence
details: AI search techniques, knowledge representation, planning, and intelligent agent design. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: CS307 - Machine Learning
details: Supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering, and neural networks. Prerequisite: MA202. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: DS304 - Visualization and App Development
details: Data visualization techniques and building interactive applications using modern frameworks. Credits: 2-1-2-0-4

title: DS305 - Legal Aspects of IT
details: IT laws, cyber regulations, intellectual property rights, and data protection laws. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: DS306 - Financial Data Analytics
details: Quantitative finance, risk modeling, algorithmic trading, and financial data analysis. Prerequisite: CS201. Credits: 2-1-2-0-4

title: DS308 - Data Security and Privacy
details: Encryption algorithms, access control, secure communication, and privacy-preserving techniques. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: DS401 - Healthcare Data Analytics
details: Applying data science to healthcare including medical imaging, EHR analysis, and clinical decision support. Prerequisite: CS201. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: CS304 - Artificial Intelligence
details: Foundations of AI including search, reasoning, natural language processing, and computer vision. Credits: 3-1-0-0-4

title: CS303 - Computer Networks
details: Network layers, TCP/IP protocol suite, LAN/WAN technologies, and network programming. Prerequisite: CS102. Credits: 3-1-2-0-5

title: DS102 - Finance and Accounting
details: Fundamentals of financial accounting, balance sheets, income statements, and cost analysis. Credits: 3-0-2-0-4
